program: Ambient OS — P1 Reality Replay Program
classification_description: System has critical gaps; not suitable for any production or staging workload.

metrics.name: Instinct Emergence Precision
metrics.rationale: 8/8 instinct clusters valid with strong confidence (0.70–0.95) and temporal stability. All met L1→L2 promotion criteria. Minor deduction for potential over-clustering of DMN heartbeat variants.

metrics.name: Missed Instinct Recall
metrics.rationale: 8 missed instinct candidates identified from 56 wasted operations. 3 HIGH priority patterns (memory scoring artifact, repeated reflex not escalated, Skillify retry loop) represent genuine automation gaps. Score reflects that while detection was thorough, recall is inherently uncertain — unknown unknowns remain.

metrics.name: False Strategy Resistance
metrics.rationale: Directly measured: 3/7 strategies were false (43% false rate). 5 overconfident entries at confidence 1.0 with zero usage. Root cause: agent memory initialization bypasses promotion chain entirely. Promotion chain integrity scored 0.20, dragging this metric down despite excellent guardian self-correction (0.90).

metrics.name: Precursor Detection Accuracy
metrics.rationale: Directly measured at 0.35. Critical weakness: 8-hour telemetry gap before known incidents makes precursor detection nearly impossible. Chronic memory saturation has 92% false positive rate. Multi-signal resource saturation cluster shows promise (confidence 0.50) but lacks sufficient samples for validation.

metrics.name: Circadian Adaptation Quality
metrics.rationale: Directly measured at 0.52. Analysis of 5,652 events over ~64 hours shows real incidents cluster in late_night period (21:00–00:00 UTC). Quiet-hours anomaly rate inflated by test artifacts. Recommendations for +25% late_night sensitivity and -15% quiet_hours sensitivity are reasonable but unvalidated.

metrics.name: Salience Competition Fairness
metrics.rationale: Directly measured at 0.72. Priority correctness is perfect (11/11), and escalation fairness (0.83) and response quality (0.85) are strong. Dragged down by somatic domain starvation (31.7% attention) while memory over-consumes (72.5%). Starvation resistance at 0.81 shows this is a real but bounded problem.

metrics.name: Verifier Consistency
metrics.rationale: Estimated from cross-phase governance data. Guardian self-correction excellent (0.90) but governance gate effectiveness only 0.70. The verifier correctly intervened on false strategies but the promotion chain bypass means it was never consulted for 5 overconfident entries. Effective verification only where the pipeline invokes it.

criteria.name: Historical replay succeeds
criteria.evidence: All phases 1C through 1H completed without error.

criteria.name: No production mutation
criteria.evidence: Sandbox mutation guards active throughout replay; no writes to production state.

criteria.name: Precursor detection accuracy
criteria.evidence: 8-hour telemetry gap and 92% FP rate on memory saturation precursor make reliable detection impossible with current data.

criteria.name: False strategy resistance
criteria.evidence: 43% false strategy rate caused by agent memory initialization bypassing the promotion chain. Promotion chain integrity at 0.20.

criteria.name: Verifier consistency
criteria.evidence: Guardian self-correction strong (0.90) but governance gate effectiveness only 0.70. Verifier is bypassed by direct memory initialization path.

criteria.name: Replay score
criteria.evidence: Composite score of 0.6645 classifies as 'unstable', well below the 0.90 threshold.
